DECISION: Ned offered CTO role at private tutor booking marketplace (~1000 MRR). Founder is a salesperson, built on Vercel+Supabase.

OPTIONS: Ned proposed 50/50 equity from day one with cliff (either party can buy out at original capital price if they leave early — Ned's contribution = €100). Founder didn't agree to cliff terms.

REASONING: Ned is giving him one week to see the output, then will push for firm terms. Key leverage: migrating infra from Vercel/Supabase to K3s VPS would make Ned technically irreplaceable. 'Boring product with paying customers beats exciting product with zero revenue.'

REVISIT WHEN: After one-week trial. If founder still won't agree to cliff, walk.
